title: God of War Laufey's $149.99 box has no game 📦
subject: godofwar
description:
Would you buy a collector's edition that doesn't include the game? 👇

The God of War Laufey Collector Box costs $149.99 and comes with an 8-inch light-up Faye statue, a 51-card Oracle Deck and a mini artbook, but no copy of the game. Pre-orders opened October 13, 2026 on PlayStation Direct. God of War Laufey launches on PS5 on February 16, 2027.

Sources: PlayStation Blog (Sept 28, 2026), PlayStation Direct product page, PlayStation LifeStyle (Oct 13, 2026)
Game images © Sony Interactive Entertainment.

scenes.text: God of War Laufey's $149.99 collector box has no game.
Pre-orders opened on October 13, only through PlayStation Direct and in highly limited quantities.
That money gets you an eight-inch light-up statue of Faye, a 51-card Oracle Deck and a mini artbook.
No disc, no download code. The product page says the game is sold separately.
In the game, Kratos's late wife Faye wakes up in an afterlife realm called the Everywhen.
The box and the game both arrive on PS5 on February 16, 2027.
